responsibility: This definition module declares the gm2 pseudo-printf formatting API built around DynamicStrings.String. It exports Sprintf0 through Sprintf4 for substituting up to four packed argument values into format strings and HandleEscape for translating backslash escapes, defining the reusable string-formatting interface used by runtime and application code without exposing the underlying parsing details.
same_name_distinction: This file is the formatting module’s interface, declaring the Sprintf0-Sprintf4 and HandleEscape entry points without exposing the parser, width/justification handling, or substitution logic implemented in FormatStrings.mod.
